appkeys.trueFriendshipDesc: We often say we have friends — but what does that really mean? This module helps you clarify what friendship represents for you and what you expect from it
appkeys.friendshipPreciousDesc: Friendship is one of the most precious bonds — and one of the least defined. We assume it, take it for granted, sometimes neglect it. But few people take the time to define what it truly means to them.
appkeys.healthyFriendshipDesc: A healthy friendship rests on several pillars: reciprocity, trust, presence in difficult moments, enjoyment of each other's company, and the freedom to be yourself without needing to justify it.

appkeys.missionText1: HEAL was created to accompany people going through breakups, emotional upheaval, or any difficult life transition. We believe everyone deserves a safe space to express their emotions, progress at their own pace, and rediscover their inner balance.
appkeys.missionText2: This app provides emotional support and guidance, but is not a medical or therapeutic service.

appkeys.gratitudeChallengeAbout: Gratitude is a powerful healing tool. By taking the time to acknowledge the positive aspects of your life, even the smallest ones, you train your mind to see beyond the pain and appreciate what surrounds you.
appkeys.exerciseStep1: Find a quiet place where you feel comfortable
appkeys.exerciseStep2: Think about the positive moments of your day, even the smallest ones.
appkeys.exerciseStep3: Write down 3 things you feel grateful for.
appkeys.exerciseStep4: For each one, write why it is important to you.
appkeys.moduleExerciseStep1: Think of the person you call your best friend.
appkeys.moduleExerciseStep2: what makes this bond different from others?
appkeys.moduleExerciseStep3: What does it give you that you don't find elsewhere?
appkeys.moduleExerciseReflectionQuestion: What is the most important quality in a friendship for you?
appkeys.moduleExerciseReflectionInstruction: In your head or on paper, take the time to answer honestly.
